issues.text: CBIMPORT: DD CARDOUT (file CARD-OUTPUT) has no DD statement in jcl/CBIMPORT.jcl
proc/TRANREPT.prc opens with '//REPROC PROC' but repeats the TRANREPT job body (EXEC PROC=REPROC, SORT, CBTRN03C); CBTRN03C is listed under both members.
CBSTM03B runs inside CREASTMT.STEP040 as a CALLed subprogram of CBSTM03A; its datasets come from that step's DDs.
COBDATFT and MVSWAIT are assembler routines under app/asm; CEE3ABD is the LE abend service. CSUTLDTC is not called by any batch program.
Batch JCL under app/app-*/jcl (IMS DFSRRC00, Db2 IKJEFT01) is outside app/jcl and app/proc and is not inventoried here.
Complexity convention taken from the ticket proposal; no Conventions skill or digest was found in the repo or plugins. DeepWiki has no index for this repo.
COCRDSEC is defined as a PROGRAM in app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD but has no source under app/cbl and no TRANSACTION; not inventoried.
XCTL/LINK targets without source in app/cbl (from menu tables COMEN02Y/COADM02Y): COPAUS0C, COTRTLIC, COTRTUPC; they appear only in external_calls.
CSUTLDTC (app/cbl/CSUTLDTC.cbl) is a static CALL from CORPT00C and COTRN02C; it has no EXEC CICS and is not a CO* program, so it is not given its own cics entry.
Return-to-caller XCTLs (MOVE CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM TO CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM) are dynamic; they are listed per program in unresolved_calls and not as edges.
COBSWAIT matches CO* but has no EXEC CICS (batch wait utility calling MVSWAIT); left to the batch group.
CORPT00C submits report JCL by EXEC CICS WRITEQ TD QUEUE('JOBS') (internal reader); recorded as dataset TDQ:JOBS.
datasets entries are objects (same shape as batch.json); spec/harness/site.py joins datasets as strings, so the merge into inventory.json must flatten them.
No DB2 precompile or BIND JCL for COBTUPDT, COTRTLIC or COTRTUPC exists in the repository; plan CARDDEMO package membership is not recorded.
DB2FREE frees PLAN(COTRTLIC), but nothing binds or references a COTRTLIC plan; CSD routes CTLI to PLAN(CARDDEMO).
COTRTLIC defines LIT-DSNTIAC but never calls DSNTIAC.
COTRTLIC 2000-SEND-MAP header (line 1274) has no terminating period; counted as a paragraph.

MQ request queue names are not in source: COPAUA0C, COACCT01 and CODATE01 take the input queue from the CICS trigger message (MQTM-QNAME); no MQ trigger/process/initiation-queue definitions are in the repo.
app-vsam-mq README lists CARDDEMO.REQUEST.QUEUE / CARDDEMO.RESPONSE.QUEUE, but COACCT01/CODATE01 hard-code reply queues CARD.DEMO.REPLY.ACCT / CARD.DEMO.REPLY.DATE and error queue CARD.DEMO.ERROR.
COPAUA0C declares CARDDAT and CARDAIX file names but only reads CCXREF, ACCTDAT and CUSTDAT.
PSBPAUTL has no user in scope (likely for an IMS load utility).
COBSWAIT is in batch and utility; kept the batch entry
CBTRN01C is in batch and utility; kept the batch entry
16 app/ members are in no group file; the merge cross-check covers them (members[].source = merge)

batch.scope: Every COBOL program under app/cbl run by EXEC PGM= in app/jcl or app/proc (system utilities excluded), plus the batch subprograms they CALL and batch programs no JCL runs.

cics.scope: Every COBOL program under app/cbl that issues EXEC CICS (CO*C online programs). Transaction ids from app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD, mapsets from app/bms, copybooks from app/cpy and app/cpy-bms, VSAM files via EXEC CICS file commands with DSN from CSD DEFINE FILE, XCTL/LINK/CALL targets as external_calls.

complexity_convention.paragraphs: paragraph and section labels in Area A of the PROCEDURE DIVISION

complexity_convention.external_calls: distinct XCTL/LINK targets (literals, LIT- constants, MOVE ... TO CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM / CCARD-NEXT-PROG, menu tables COMEN02Y/COADM02Y) plus distinct static CALL targets

method.paragraphs: paragraph headers in Area A of the program member's PROCEDURE DIVISION (procedure copybooks not expanded; their paragraphs are listed under copybook_contributions)
method.external_calls: CALL, EXEC CICS XCTL and EXEC CICS LINK statements
method.file_io_verbs: native OPEN/CLOSE/READ/WRITE/REWRITE/DELETE/START on files, EXEC CICS file commands (none present), and every executable EXEC SQL statement in the member (SELECT INTO, FETCH, OPEN/CLOSE cursor, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE). EXEC SQL INCLUDE and DECLARE CURSOR are not counted.

ims-mq.scope: Every COBOL program under app/app-authorization-ims-db2-mq/cbl and app/app-vsam-mq/cbl, with IMS DBDs/PSBs, MQ queues, Db2 tables, JCL steps and CICS transactions from the same modules. Inventory only.

complexity_convention.file_io_verbs: occurrences in the PROCEDURE DIVISION (comments and literals excluded) of COBOL OPEN/CLOSE/READ/WRITE/REWRITE/DELETE/START, EXEC CICS file commands (READ, WRITE, REWRITE, DELETE, UNLOCK, STARTBR, READNEXT, READPREV, RESETBR, ENDBR), executable EXEC SQL statements (INCLUDE/DECLARE/WHENEVER excluded), DL/I calls (EXEC DLI and CALL 'CBLTDLI', including SCHD/TERM/CHKP) and MQ API calls (MQOPEN, MQGET, MQPUT, MQPUT1, MQCLOSE)
complexity_convention.external_calls: distinct targets of CALL (other than CBLTDLI and MQ API, counted as I/O), EXEC CICS XCTL and LINK; XCTL PROGRAM(CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM) resolved to the literal targets MOVEd into it
